hotspots.label: Sign before dispatch
hotspots.text: “Confirmation must be signed and returned before driver can be dispatched.” No signed rate con, no load.

hotspots.label: Miles 240 (loaded)
hotspots.text: Loaded miles only. Add your deadhead to get rate per total mile.

hotspots.label: Flat rate $700 = all-in
hotspots.text: No separate fuel line; this is the invoice amount. $700 ÷ 240 = $2.92 per loaded mile.

hotspots.label: Weight 2,000 lb
hotspots.text: Compare with the BOL at pickup: BOL says 5,729 lb.

hotspots.label: Tracking: $150 deduction
hotspots.text: Driver must accept MacroPoint tracking or $150 is deducted.

hotspots.label: POD in 72 h or $150
hotspots.text: POD must be emailed/faxed within 72 hours of delivery.

hotspots.label: Liability and no TONU
hotspots.text: Carrier responsible for shortages, damages and late fees; broker not liable for Truck Order Not Used.

hotspots.label: Invoices to AP email
hotspots.text: Send invoices and BOLs to the AP address printed on the rate con.

hotspots.label: Carrier signature
hotspots.text: Only someone the carrier authorizes signs (dispatch agreement).

hotspots.label: Shipper
hotspots.text: Green Bay Packaging, Lebanon, OH: matches the rate con pickup.

hotspots.label: Ship to
hotspots.text: Tracco LLC, Owensboro, KY: matches the consignee.

hotspots.label: BOL #
hotspots.text: BOL# 22722019: note it on your records; it becomes the POD reference.

hotspots.label: Carrier line blank
hotspots.text: CARRIER CO: is blank. It should name your carrier; a different carrier or broker name is a stop sign.

hotspots.label: Total weight 5,729 lb
hotspots.text: Rate con said 2,000 lb. Driver waits; you call the broker and get the change in writing.

hotspots.label: Same BOL #
hotspots.text: The BOL becomes the POD when the receiver signs it.

hotspots.label: Total units 10
hotspots.text: Count on the BOL…

hotspots.label: Qty received 10
hotspots.text: …matches the receiver’s stamp.

hotspots.label: Over/Short/Damaged blank
hotspots.text: Blank = clean delivery.

hotspots.label: Received by
hotspots.text: Signature and date; printed name and time would be better.

hotspots.label: Driver signature blank
hotspots.text: Coach drivers to complete signature and date/time lines.
